description.en: The membrane-associated protein encoded by this gene is a member of the superfamily of ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporters. ABC proteins transport various molecules across extra- and intra-cellular membranes. ABC genes are divided into seven distinct subfamilies (ABC1, MDR/TAP, MRP, ALD, OABP, GCN20, White).
description.ru: АТФ-зависимый мембранный транспортёр семейства ABC; участвует в переносе фосфолипидов в желчь.

description.en: The membrane-associated protein encoded by this gene is included in the superfamily of ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporters. ABC proteins transport various molecules across extra- and intra-cellular membranes. ABC genes are divided into seven distinct subfamilies (ABC1, MDR/TAP, MRP, ALD, OABP, GCN20, White).
description.ru: Мембранный транспортёр семейства ABC, выводящий различные молекулы из клетки.

description.en: This gene is expressed in adipose tissue exclusively. It encodes a protein with similarity to collagens X and VIII and complement factor C1q. The encoded protein circulates in the plasma and is involved with metabolic and hormonal processes.
description.ru: Кодирует адипонектин — секретируемый жировой тканью белок, связанный с обменом глюкозы и липидов.

description.en: The adrenergic receptors (subtypes alpha 1, alpha 2, beta 1, and beta 2) are a prototypic family of guanine nucleotide binding regulatory protein-coupled receptors that mediate the physiological effects of the hormone epinephrine and the neurotransmitter norepinephrine. Beta-1 adrenoceptors are predominately located in the heart.
description.ru: Бета-1-адренорецептор передаёт клетке сигналы адренергической системы.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene, pre-angiotensinogen or angiotensinogen precursor, is expressed in the liver and is cleaved by the enzyme renin in response to lowered blood pressure. The resulting product, angiotensin I, is then cleaved by angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) to generate the physiologically active peptide angiotensin II. The protein is involved in maintaining blood pressure, body fluid and electrolyte homeostasis, and in the pathogenesis of essential hypertension and preeclampsia.
description.ru: Кодирует ангиотензиноген — предшественник пептидов ренин-ангиотензиновой системы.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a class III pyridoxal-phosphate-dependent mitochondrial aminotransferase. It catalyzes the conversion of glyoxylate to glycine using L-alanine as the amino donor. It is an important regulator of methylarginines and is involved in the control of blood pressure in kidney.
description.ru: Митохондриальная аминотрансфераза; участвует в превращениях глиоксилата и аминокислот.

description.en: This protein belongs to the aldehyde dehydrogenase family of proteins. Aldehyde dehydrogenase is the second enzyme of the major oxidative pathway of alcohol metabolism. Two major liver isoforms of aldehyde dehydrogenase, cytosolic and mitochondrial, can be distinguished by their electrophoretic mobilities, kinetic properties, and subcellular localizations.
description.ru: Альдегиддегидрогеназа участвует в окислении альдегидов, включая ацетальдегид в обмене алкоголя.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the alkaline phosphatase family of proteins. There are at least four distinct but related alkaline phosphatases: intestinal, placental, placental-like, and liver/bone/kidney (tissue non-specific). The first three are located together on chromosome 2, while the tissue non-specific form is located on chromosome 1.
description.ru: Тканенеспецифическая щелочная фосфатаза участвует в процессах минерализации.

description.en: This gene encodes a metal-binding membrane glycoprotein that oxidatively deaminates putrescine, histamine, and related compounds. The encoded protein is inhibited by amiloride, a diuretic that acts by closing epithelial sodium ion channels.
description.ru: Медьсодержащая аминоксидаза катализирует окислительное дезаминирование гистамина и родственных аминов.

description.en: This gene product is the main apolipoprotein of chylomicrons and low density lipoproteins (LDL), and is the ligand for the LDL receptor. It occurs in plasma as two main isoforms, apoB-48 and apoB-100: the former is synthesized exclusively in the gut and the latter in the liver. The intestinal and the hepatic forms of apoB are encoded by a single gene from a single, very long mRNA.
description.ru: Аполипопротеин B — структурный компонент липопротеинов и лиганд рецептора ЛПНП.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a major apoprotein of the chylomicron. It binds to a specific liver and peripheral cell receptor, and is essential for the normal catabolism of triglyceride-rich lipoprotein constituents. This gene maps to chromosome 19 in a cluster with the related apolipoprotein C1 and C2 genes.
description.ru: Аполипопротеин E участвует в рецепторном захвате и обмене липопротеиновых частиц.

description.en: This gene encodes a secreted high density lipoprotein which binds to apolipoprotein A-I. Apolipoprotein A-I is a relatively abundant plasma protein and is the major apoprotein of HDL. It is involved in the formation of most cholesteryl esters in plasma and also promotes efflux of cholesterol from cells.
description.ru: Аполипопротеин L1 — белок, связанный с липопротеинами и мембранными процессами.

description.en: The androgen receptor gene is more than 90 kb long and codes for a protein that has 3 major functional domains: the N-terminal domain, DNA-binding domain, and androgen-binding domain. The protein functions as a steroid-hormone activated transcription factor. Upon binding the hormone ligand, the receptor dissociates from accessory proteins, translocates into the nucleus, dimerizes, and then stimulates transcription of androgen responsive genes.
description.ru: Андрогенный рецептор связывает андрогены и регулирует транскрипцию генов.

description.en: Predicted to enable acyltransferase activity, transferring groups other than amino-acyl groups; asparaginase activity; and phosphatidylcholine lysophospholipase A1 activity. Predicted to be involved in asparagine metabolic process and phospholipid metabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytosol.
description.ru: Для белка предполагается аспарагиназная и другая ферментативная активность; источник обозначает часть функций как предсказанные.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene acts as receptor for arginine vasopressin. This receptor belongs to the subfamily of G-protein coupled receptors which includes AVPR1B, V2R and OXT receptors. Its activity is mediated by G proteins which stimulate a phosphatidylinositol-calcium second messenger system.
description.ru: Рецептор вазопрессина передаёт сигнал через G-белки.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the BCL-2 protein family. BCL-2 family members form hetero- or homodimers and act as anti- or pro-apoptotic regulators that are involved in a wide variety of cellular activities. The protein encoded by this gene contains a Bcl-2 homology domain 3 (BH3).
description.ru: Белок семейства BCL2 участвует в регуляции программируемой гибели клеток.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the nerve growth factor family of proteins. Binding of this protein to its cognate receptor promotes neuronal survival in the adult brain.
description.ru: Нейротрофический фактор участвует в поддержании и развитии нейронов.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the BCL2 protein family. BCL2 family members form hetero- or homodimers and act as anti- or pro-apoptotic regulators that are involved in a wide variety of cellular activities. This protein contains a single BCL2 homology domain 3 (BH3), and has been shown to bind BCL2 proteins and function as an apoptotic activator.
description.ru: Белок семейства BCL2 участвует в регуляции апоптоза.

description.en: Complement component C3 plays a central role in the activation of complement system. Its activation is required for both classical and alternative complement activation pathways. The encoded preproprotein is proteolytically processed to generate alpha and beta subunits that form the mature protein, which is then further processed to generate numerous peptide products.
description.ru: Компонент комплемента C3 участвует в активации классического и альтернативного путей комплемента.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene acts as a homotetramer to catalyze the conversion of homocysteine to cystathionine, the first step in the transsulfuration pathway. The encoded protein is allosterically activated by adenosyl-methionine and uses pyridoxal phosphate as a cofactor. This gene is a major contributor to cellular hydrogen sulfide production.
description.ru: Цистатионин-бета-синтаза превращает гомоцистеин в цистатионин в пути транссульфурации.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the methylthiotransferase family. The function of this gene is not known.
description.ru: Белок семейства метилтиотрансфераз; в справочной записи точная функция обозначена как не полностью установленная.

description.en: This gene encodes the pro-alpha1 chains of type I collagen whose triple helix comprises two alpha1 chains and one alpha2 chain. Type I is a fibril-forming collagen found in most connective tissues and is abundant in bone, cornea, dermis and tendon. Two transcripts, resulting from the use of alternate polyadenylation signals, have been identified for this gene.
description.ru: Кодирует альфа-1-цепь коллагена I — компонента соединительной ткани.

description.en: This transcribed pseudogene represents the 5' end of a presumed ortholog to a mouse gene which encodes a collagen VI alpha 4 chain protein (GeneID 68553). No complete ORF of comparable size to the mouse protein is found in this gene. The predicted protein lacks a signal peptide; however, this truncated collagen polypeptide may have achieved a different function as suggested by PubMed ID: 18622395.
description.ru: Транскрибируемый псевдоген, связанный с фрагментом предполагаемого ортолога коллагена VI; доказательства трансляции неполны.

description.en: Catechol-O-methyltransferase catalyzes the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to catecholamines, including the neurotransmitters dopamine, epinephrine, and norepinephrine. This O-methylation results in one of the major degradative pathways of the catecholamine transmitters. COMT is found in two forms in tissues, a soluble form (S-COMT) and a membrane-bound form (MB-COMT).
description.ru: Катехол-О-метилтрансфераза переносит метильную группу на катехоламины, включая дофамин и норадреналин.

description.en: In eukaryotic cells, protein transport between the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi compartments is mediated in part by non-clathrin-coated vesicular coat proteins (COPs). Seven coat proteins have been identified, and they represent subunits of a complex known as coatomer. The subunits are designated alpha-COP, beta-COP, beta-prime-COP, gamma-COP, delta-COP, epsilon-COP, and zeta-COP.
description.ru: Субъединица комплекса COPI участвует в везикулярном транспорте между эндоплазматическим ретикулумом и аппаратом Гольджи.

description.en: The mitochondrial enzyme encoded by this gene catalyzes synthesis of carbamoyl phosphate from ammonia and bicarbonate. This reaction is the first committed step of the urea cycle, which is important in the removal of excess urea from cells. The encoded protein may also represent a core mitochondrial nucleoid protein.
description.ru: Митохондриальная карбамоилфосфатсинтетаза катализирует первый обязательный этап цикла мочевины.

description.en: This gene encodes a G-protein coupled receptor that binds neuropeptides of the corticotropin releasing hormone family that are major regulators of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal pathway. The encoded protein is essential for the activation of signal transduction pathways that regulate diverse physiological processes including stress, reproduction, immune response and obesity. Naturally-occurring readthrough transcription between this gene and upstream GeneID:147081 results in transcripts that encode isoforms that share similarity with the products of this gene.
description.ru: Рецептор кортикотропин-рилизинг-гормона участвует в передаче сигналов гипоталамо-гипофизарно-надпочечниковой системы.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the pentraxin family which also includes serum amyloid P component protein and pentraxin 3. Pentraxins are involved in complement activation and amplification via communication with complement initiation pattern recognition molecules, but also complement regulation via recruitment of complement regulators. The encoded protein has a calcium dependent ligand binding domain with a distinctive flattened beta-jellyroll structure.
description.ru: С-реактивный белок относится к пентраксинам, связанным с врождённым иммунитетом и комплементом.

description.en: This gene is a member of the immunoglobulin superfamily and encodes a protein which transmits an inhibitory signal to T cells. The protein contains a V domain, a transmembrane domain, and a cytoplasmic tail. The membrane-bound isoform functions as a homodimer interconnected by a disulfide bond, while the soluble isoform functions as a monomer.
description.ru: Передаёт тормозящий сигнал T-лимфоцитам и участвует в регуляции иммунного ответа.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the cytochrome P450 superfamily of enzymes. The cytochrome P450 proteins are monooxygenases which catalyze many reactions involved in drug metabolism and synthesis of cholesterol, steroids and other lipids. This protein localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum.
description.ru: Фермент цитохрома P450 участвует в гидроксилировании и расщеплении стероидных предшественников.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the cytochrome P450 superfamily of enzymes. The cytochrome P450 proteins are monooxygenases which catalyze many reactions involved in drug metabolism and synthesis of cholesterol, steroids and other lipids. This protein localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum and catalyzes the last steps of estrogen biosynthesis.
description.ru: Ароматаза семейства цитохрома P450 участвует в превращении андрогенных предшественников в эстрогены.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the cytochrome P450 superfamily of enzymes. The cytochrome P450 proteins are monooxygenases which catalyze many reactions involved in drug metabolism and synthesis of cholesterol, steroids and other lipids. This protein localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum and is known to metabolize many xenobiotics, including the anticonvulsive drug mephenytoin, omeprazole, diazepam and some barbiturates.
description.ru: Фермент цитохрома P450 участвует в метаболизме лекарств и других соединений; функция гена не определяет полный диплотип.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the cytochrome P450 superfamily of enzymes. The cytochrome P450 proteins are monooxygenases which catalyze many reactions involved in drug metabolism and synthesis of cholesterol, steroids and other lipids. This protein localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum and its expression is induced by rifampin.
description.ru: Фермент цитохрома P450 участвует в окислительном метаболизме различных соединений.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the cytochrome P450 superfamily of enzymes. The cytochrome P450 proteins are monooxygenases which catalyze many reactions involved in drug metabolism and synthesis of cholesterol, steroids and other lipids. This enzyme is a microsomal vitamin D hydroxylase that converts vitamin D into the active ligand for the vitamin D receptor.
description.ru: Фермент цитохрома P450 участвует в 25-гидроксилировании витамина D.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the cytochrome P450 superfamily of enzymes. The cytochrome P450 proteins are monooxygenases which catalyze many reactions involved in drug metabolism and synthesis of cholesterol, steroids and other lipids. This protein localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum.
description.ru: Фермент цитохрома P450 участвует в окислении жирных кислот и других липидных субстратов.

description.en: This gene encodes an enzyme that removes the C(7-8) double bond in the B ring of sterols and catalyzes the conversion of 7-dehydrocholesterol to cholesterol. This gene is ubiquitously expressed and its transmembrane protein localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum membrane and nuclear outer membrane.
description.ru: Восстанавливает 7-дегидрохолестерин до холестерина.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the iodothyronine deiodinase family. It catalyzes the activation, as well as the inactivation of thyroid hormone by outer and inner ring deiodination, respectively. The activation reaction involves the conversion of the prohormone thyroxine (3,5,3',5'-tetraiodothyronine, T4), secreted by the thyroid gland, to the bioactive thyroid hormone (3,5,3'-triiodothyronine, T3) by 5'-deiodination.
description.ru: Дейодиназа участвует в активации и инактивации тиреоидных гормонов.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the iodothyronine deiodinase family. It catalyzes the conversion of prohormone thyroxine (3,5,3',5'-tetraiodothyronine, T4) to the bioactive thyroid hormone (3,5,3'-triiodothyronine, T3) by outer ring 5'-deiodination. This gene is widely expressed, including in thyroid and brain.
description.ru: Дейодиназа превращает тироксин T4 в активный трийодтиронин T3.

description.en: This gene encodes the D1 subtype of the dopamine receptor. The D1 subtype is the most abundant dopamine receptor in the central nervous system. This G-protein coupled receptor stimulates adenylyl cyclase and activates cyclic AMP-dependent protein kinases.
description.ru: Дофаминовый рецептор D1 передаёт сигнал через G-белки и стимулирует аденилатциклазу.

description.en: This gene encodes the D2 subtype of the dopamine receptor. This G-protein coupled receptor inhibits adenylyl cyclase activity.
description.ru: Дофаминовый рецептор D2 передаёт сигнал через G-белки и тормозит аденилатциклазу.

description.en: This gene encodes the D4 subtype of the dopamine receptor. The D4 subtype is a G-protein coupled receptor which inhibits adenylyl cyclase. This gene contains a polymorphic number (2-10 copies) of tandem 48 nt repeats; the sequence shown contains four repeats.
description.ru: Дофаминовый рецептор D4 передаёт сигнал через G-белки.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a glycoprotein and a member of the NADPH oxidase family. The synthesis of thyroid hormone is catalyzed by a protein complex located at the apical membrane of thyroid follicular cells. This complex contains an iodide transporter, thyroperoxidase, and a peroxide generating system that includes this encoded protein and DUOX1.
description.ru: Фермент семейства NADPH-оксидаз участвует в образовании перекиси водорода для синтеза тиреоидных гормонов.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a type II transmembrane protein that is similar to two families of cell adhesion molecules, the protocadherins and ependymins. This protein may play a role in calcium-dependent cell adhesion. This protein is glycosylated, and the orthologous mouse protein is localized to the lysosome.
description.ru: Белок, сходный с молекулами клеточной адгезии; справочник описывает отдельные функции предположительно.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is an aminopeptidase involved in trimming HLA class I-binding precursors so that they can be presented on MHC class I molecules. The encoded protein acts as a monomer or as a heterodimer with ERAP2. This protein may also be involved in blood pressure regulation by inactivation of angiotensin II.
description.ru: Аминопептидаза подрезает пептиды для представления молекулами MHC класса I.

description.en: This gene encodes an estrogen receptor and ligand-activated transcription factor. The canonical protein contains an N-terminal ligand-independent transactivation domain, a central DNA binding domain, a hinge domain, and a C-terminal ligand-dependent transactivation domain. The protein localizes to the nucleus where it may form either a homodimer or a heterodimer with estrogen receptor 2.
description.ru: Эстрогенный рецептор — активируемый лигандом транскрипционный фактор.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the family of estrogen receptors and superfamily of nuclear receptor transcription factors. The gene product contains an N-terminal DNA binding domain and C-terminal ligand binding domain and is localized to the nucleus, cytoplasm, and mitochondria. Upon binding to 17beta-estradiol or related ligands, the encoded protein forms homo- or hetero-dimers that interact with specific DNA sequences to activate transcription.
description.ru: Эстрогенный рецептор семейства ядерных рецепторов регулирует транскрипцию.

description.en: This gene encodes the coagulation factor XIII A subunit. Coagulation factor XIII is the last zymogen to become activated in the blood coagulation cascade. Plasma factor XIII is a heterotetramer composed of 2 A subunits and 2 B subunits.
description.ru: Кодирует субъединицу A фактора XIII, участвующего в стабилизации фибринового сгустка.

description.en: This gene encodes the prothrombin protein (also known as coagulation factor II). This protein is proteolytically cleaved in multiple steps to form the activated serine protease thrombin. The activated thrombin enzyme plays an important role in thrombosis and hemostasis by converting fibrinogen to fibrin during blood clot formation, by stimulating platelet aggregation, and by activating additional coagulation factors.
description.ru: Кодирует протромбин, из которого образуется тромбин — протеаза каскада свёртывания крови.

description.en: This gene encodes an essential cofactor of the blood coagulation cascade. This factor circulates in plasma, and is converted to the active form by the release of the activation peptide by thrombin during coagulation. This generates a heavy chain and a light chain which are held together by calcium ions.
description.ru: Кодирует фактор V — кофактор каскада свёртывания крови.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the fatty acid desaturase (FADS) gene family. Desaturase enzymes regulate unsaturation of fatty acids through the introduction of double bonds between defined carbons of the fatty acyl chain. FADS family members are considered fusion products composed of an N-terminal cytochrome b5-like domain and a C-terminal multiple membrane-spanning desaturase portion, both of which are characterized by conserved histidine motifs.
description.ru: Десатураза вводит двойные связи в жирные кислоты.

description.en: This gene is a member of a gene family which arose through duplication on the X chromosome. The encoded protein may be localized to the nucleus as the protein contains several nuclear localization signals, and has similarity to a synaptonemal complex protein.
description.ru: Белок семейства FAM9 может локализоваться в ядре; точная функция в справочной записи не установлена.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the TNF-receptor superfamily. This receptor contains a death domain. The interaction of this receptor with its ligand allows the formation of a death-inducing signaling complex that includes Fas-associated death domain protein (FADD), caspase 8, and caspase 10.
description.ru: Рецептор семейства TNF участвует в передаче сигналов программируемой гибели клеток.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is the beta component of fibrinogen, a blood-borne glycoprotein comprised of three pairs of nonidentical polypeptide chains. Following vascular injury, fibrinogen is cleaved by thrombin to form fibrin which is the most abundant component of blood clots. In addition, various cleavage products of fibrinogen and fibrin regulate cell adhesion and spreading, display vasoconstrictor and chemotactic activities, and are mitogens for several cell types.
description.ru: Кодирует бета-цепь фибриногена, из которого образуется фибрин сгустка.

description.en: This intronless gene encodes a protein that belongs to the forkhead family of transcription factors. Members of this family contain a conserved 100-amino acid DNA-binding 'forkhead' domain. The encoded protein functions as a thyroid transcription factor that plays a role in thyroid morphogenesis.
description.ru: Транскрипционный фактор семейства forkhead участвует в развитии щитовидной железы.

description.en: This gene is a nuclear protein of the AlkB related non-haem iron and 2-oxoglutarate-dependent oxygenase superfamily but the exact physiological function of this gene is not known. Other non-heme iron enzymes function to reverse alkylated DNA and RNA damage by oxidative demethylation. Studies in mice and humans indicate a role in nervous and cardiovascular systems and a strong association with body mass index, obesity risk, and type 2 diabetes.
description.ru: Кодирует фермент, связанный с модификацией нуклеиновых кислот; функции и ассоциации вариантов различаются.

description.en: This gene is one of two encoding the galactoside 2-L-fucosyltransferase enzyme. The encoded protein is important for the final step in the soluble ABO blood group antigen synthesis pathway. It is also involved in cell-cell interaction, cell surface expression, and cell proliferation.
description.ru: Фукозилтрансфераза участвует в образовании углеводных антигенов в секретах.

description.en: This gene encodes glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase. This protein is a cytosolic enzyme encoded by a housekeeping X-linked gene whose main function is to produce NADPH, a key electron donor in the defense against oxidizing agents and in reductive biosynthetic reactions. G6PD is remarkable for its genetic diversity.
description.ru: Глюкозо-6-фосфатдегидрогеназа образует NADPH в пентозофосфатном пути.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the albumin gene family. It is a multifunctional protein found in plasma, ascitic fluid, cerebrospinal fluid and on the surface of many cell types. It binds to vitamin D and its plasma metabolites and transports them to target tissues.
description.ru: Кодирует белок, связывающий и переносящий витамин D и его метаболиты.

description.en: This gene encodes a protein belonging to the GCKR subfamily of the SIS (Sugar ISomerase) family of proteins. The gene product is a regulatory protein that inhibits glucokinase in liver and pancreatic islet cells by binding non-covalently to form an inactive complex with the enzyme.
description.ru: Регуляторный белок глюкокиназы участвует в контроле её активности.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a mitochondrial phosphate-activated glutaminase that catalyzes the hydrolysis of glutamine to stoichiometric amounts of glutamate and ammonia. Originally thought to be liver-specific, this protein has been found in other tissues as well.
description.ru: Глутаминаза катализирует превращение глутамина в глутамат.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is an enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of S-adenosyl-L-methionine (along with glycine) to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine and sarcosine. This protein is found in the cytoplasm and acts as a homotetramer. Naturally occurring readthrough transcription occurs between the upstream CNPY3 (canopy FGF signaling regulator 3) gene and this gene and is represented with GeneID:107080644.
description.ru: Глицин-N-метилтрансфераза участвует в обмене метильных групп.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the glutathione peroxidase family, members of which catalyze the reduction of organic hydroperoxides and hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) by glutathione, and thereby protect cells against oxidative damage. Other studies indicate that H2O2 is also essential for growth-factor mediated signal transduction, mitochondrial function, and maintenance of thiol redox-balance; therefore, by limiting H2O2 accumulation, glutathione peroxidases are also involved in modulating these processes. Several isozymes of this gene family exist in vertebrates, which vary in cellular location and substrate specificity.
description.ru: Глутатионпероксидаза восстанавливает перекиси с использованием глутатиона.

description.en: This gene is an estrogen-responsive gene that is an early response gene in the estrogen receptor-regulated pathway.
description.ru: Эстроген-регулируемый ген; его продукт связан с ответом клеток на эстрогенные сигналы.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the gasdermin-domain containing protein family.
description.ru: Белок семейства газдерминов, связанного с образованием мембранных пор.

description.en: Glutathione S-transferases (GSTs) are a family of enzymes that play an important role in detoxification by catalyzing the conjugation of many hydrophobic and electrophilic compounds with reduced glutathione. Based on their biochemical, immunologic, and structural properties, the soluble GSTs are categorized into 4 main classes: alpha, mu, pi, and theta.
description.ru: Глутатион-S-трансфераза участвует в конъюгации соединений с глутатионом.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a membrane protein that is similar to MHC class I-type proteins and associates with beta2-microglobulin (beta2M). It is thought that this protein functions to regulate iron absorption by regulating the interaction of the transferrin receptor with transferrin.
description.ru: Мембранный белок участвует в регуляции обмена железа.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the homeobox family of transcription factors, many of which are involved in developmental processes. Expression in specific hematopoietic lineages suggests that this protein may play a role in hematopoietic differentiation.
description.ru: Гомеобоксный транскрипционный фактор участвует в развитии тканей.

description.en: HLA-B belongs to the HLA class I heavy chain paralogues. This class I molecule is a heterodimer consisting of a heavy chain and a light chain (beta-2 microglobulin). The heavy chain is anchored in the membrane.
description.ru: Молекула MHC класса I представляет пептиды иммунным клеткам.

description.en: HLA-DQA1 belongs to the HLA class II alpha chain paralogues. The class II molecule is a heterodimer consisting of an alpha (DQA) and a beta chain (DQB), both anchored in the membrane. It plays a central role in the immune system by presenting peptides derived from extracellular proteins.
description.ru: Альфа-цепь молекулы MHC класса II участвует в представлении пептидов.

description.en: This gene encodes a G protein-coupled receptor for 5-hydroxytryptamine (serotonin), and belongs to the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor subfamily. Serotonin has been implicated in a number of physiologic processes and pathologic conditions. Inactivation of this gene in mice results in behavior consistent with an increased anxiety and stress response.
description.ru: Серотониновый рецептор передаёт сигнал через G-белки.

description.en: This gene encodes one of the receptors for serotonin, a neurotransmitter with many roles.
description.ru: Серотониновый рецептор передаёт сигнал через G-белки.

description.en: IFIH1 encodes MDA5 which is an intracellular sensor of viral RNA that triggers the innate immune response. Sensing RNA length and secondary structure, MDA5 binds dsRNA oligonucleotides with a modified DExD/H-box helicase core and a C-terminal domain, thus leading to a proinflammatory response that includes interferons. It has been shown that Coronaviruses (CoVs) as well as various other virus families, are capable of evading the MDA5-dependent interferon response, thus impeding the activation of the innate immune response to infection.
description.ru: Рецептор распознавания вирусной РНК участвует во врождённом противовирусном ответе.

description.en: This gene (IFNGR1) encodes the ligand-binding chain (alpha) of the gamma interferon receptor. Human interferon-gamma receptor is a heterodimer of IFNGR1 and IFNGR2.
description.ru: Субъединица рецептора интерферона-гамма участвует в передаче его сигнала.

description.en: The expression of this protein is restricted to the fetal and adult hemo-lymphopoietic system, and it functions as a regulator of lymphocyte differentiation. Most isoforms share a common C-terminal domain, which contains two zinc finger motifs that are required for hetero- or homo-dimerization, and for interactions with other proteins. The isoforms, however, differ in the number of N-terminal zinc finger motifs that bind DNA and in nuclear localization signal presence, resulting in members with and without DNA-binding properties.
description.ru: Транскрипционный фактор Ikaros участвует в развитии и регуляции лимфоидных клеток.

description.en: This gene encodes an immunoregulatory cytokine produced primarily by activated Th2 cells. This cytokine is involved in several stages of B-cell maturation and differentiation. It up-regulates CD23 and MHC class II expression, and promotes IgE isotype switching of B cells.
description.ru: Цитокин участвует в регуляции иммунных и воспалительных ответов.

description.en: The interleukin 2 (IL2) receptor alpha (IL2RA) and beta (IL2RB) chains, together with the common gamma chain (IL2RG), constitute the high-affinity IL2 receptor. Homodimeric alpha chains (IL2RA) result in low-affinity receptor, while homodimeric beta (IL2RB) chains produce a medium-affinity receptor. Normally an integral-membrane protein, soluble IL2RA has been isolated and determined to result from extracellular proteolyisis.
description.ru: Альфа-цепь рецептора интерлейкина-2 участвует в иммунной сигнализации.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the interleukin 1 cytokine family. This cytokine was shown to specifically inhibit the activation of NF-kappaB induced by interleukin 1 family, member 6 (IL1F6). This gene and eight other interleukin 1 family genes form a cytokine gene cluster on chromosome 2.
description.ru: Антагонист рецептора интерлейкина-36 регулирует воспалительную сигнализацию.

description.en: This gene encodes a subunit of the interleukin 6 (IL6) receptor complex. Interleukin 6 is a potent pleiotropic cytokine that regulates cell growth and differentiation and plays an important role in the immune response. The IL6 receptor is a protein complex consisting of this protein and interleukin 6 signal transducer (IL6ST/GP130/IL6-beta), a receptor subunit also shared by many other cytokines.
description.ru: Субъединица рецептора интерлейкина-6 участвует в передаче его сигнала.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the interferon regulatory factor (IRF) family, a group of transcription factors with diverse roles, including virus-mediated activation of interferon, and modulation of cell growth, differentiation, apoptosis, and immune system activity. Members of the IRF family are characterized by a conserved N-terminal DNA-binding domain containing tryptophan (W) repeats.
description.ru: Транскрипционный фактор участвует в регуляции интерфероновых и иммунных ответов.

description.en: This gene encodes the alpha subunit of a transmembrane receptor for collagens and related proteins. The encoded protein forms a heterodimer with a beta subunit and mediates the adhesion of platelets and other cell types to the extracellular matrix. This gene is located adjacent to a related alpha subunit gene.
description.ru: Альфа-2-субъединица интегрина участвует в взаимодействии клеток с коллагеном.

description.en: The ITGB3 protein product is the integrin beta chain beta 3. Integrins are integral cell-surface proteins composed of an alpha chain and a beta chain. A given chain may combine with multiple partners resulting in different integrins.
description.ru: Бета-3-субъединица интегрина участвует в клеточной адгезии; входит в тромбоцитарный рецепторный комплекс.

description.en: Potassium channels are present in most mammalian cells, where they participate in a wide range of physiologic responses. The protein encoded by this gene is an integral membrane protein and inward-rectifier type potassium channel. Defects in this gene may also contribute to autosomal dominant non-insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus type II (NIDDM), transient neonatal diabetes mellitus type 3 (TNDM3), and permanent neonatal diabetes mellitus (PNDM).
description.ru: Субъединица калиевого канала участвует в связи энергетического состояния клетки с электрической активностью.

description.en: This gene encodes a voltage-gated potassium channel required for repolarization phase of the cardiac action potential. This protein can form heteromultimers with two other potassium channel proteins, KCNE1 and KCNE3. This gene exhibits tissue-specific imprinting, with preferential expression from the maternal allele in some tissues, and biallelic expression in others.
description.ru: Субъединица потенциал-зависимого калиевого канала участвует в регуляции мембранного потенциала.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a serine proteinase that inhibits the activity of tissue-type plasminogen activator I. The encoded protein constitutes a substantial portion of lipoprotein(a) and is proteolytically cleaved, resulting in fragments that attach to atherosclerotic lesions and promote thrombogenesis. Elevated plasma levels of this protein are linked to atherosclerosis.
description.ru: Кодирует аполипопротеин(a), компонент частицы липопротеина(a).

description.en: This gene encodes a transmembrane low-density lipoprotein receptor that binds and internalizes ligands in the process of receptor-mediated endocytosis. This protein also acts as a co-receptor with Frizzled protein family members for transducing signals by Wnt proteins and was originally cloned on the basis of its association with type 1 diabetes mellitus in humans.
description.ru: Мембранный рецептор участвует в передаче Wnt-сигнала.

description.en: This gene is one of two neighboring gene family members that encode mitochondrial enzymes which catalyze the oxidative deamination of amines, such as dopamine, norepinephrine, and serotonin.
description.ru: Моноаминоксидаза катализирует окислительное дезаминирование моноаминов.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the flavin monoamine oxidase family. It is a enzyme located in the mitochondrial outer membrane. It catalyzes the oxidative deamination of biogenic and xenobiotic amines and plays an important role in the metabolism of neuroactive and vasoactive amines in the central nervous sysytem and peripheral tissues.
description.ru: Моноаминоксидаза катализирует окислительное дезаминирование моноаминов.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a membrane-bound receptor and member of the melanocortin receptor family. The encoded protein interacts with adrenocorticotropic and MSH hormones and is mediated by G proteins. This is an intronless gene.
description.ru: Меланокортиновый рецептор участвует в регуляции энергетического баланса.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is one of the highly conserved mini-chromosome maintenance proteins (MCM) that are essential for the initiation of eukaryotic genome replication. The hexameric protein complex formed by the MCM proteins is a key component of the pre-replication complex (pre_RC) and may be involved in the formation of replication forks and in the recruitment of other DNA replication related proteins. The MCM complex consisting of this protein and MCM2, 4 and 7 proteins possesses DNA helicase activity, and may act as a DNA unwinding enzyme.
description.ru: Белок комплекса MCM участвует в репликации ДНК; функция белка не равнозначна эффекту соседнего регуляторного варианта.

description.en: This gene encodes a protein, also known as pyrin or marenostrin, that is an important modulator of innate immunity.
description.ru: Кодирует пирин — белок, участвующий в регуляции врождённого иммунитета и воспаления.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene catalyzes the conversion of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, a co-substrate for homocysteine remethylation to methionine.
description.ru: Метилентетрагидрофолатредуктаза участвует в образовании 5-метилтетрагидрофолата.

description.en: This gene encodes one of two high affinity forms of a receptor for melatonin, the primary hormone secreted by the pineal gland. This gene product is an integral membrane protein that is a G-protein coupled, 7-transmembrane receptor. It is found primarily in the retina and brain although this detection requires RT-PCR.
description.ru: Мелатониновый рецептор передаёт сигнал через G-белки.

description.en: This gene encodes the 5-methyltetrahydrofolate-homocysteine methyltransferase. This enzyme, also known as cobalamin-dependent methionine synthase, catalyzes the final step in methionine biosynthesis.
description.ru: Метионинсинтаза участвует в превращении гомоцистеина в метионин.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the ferredoxin-NADP(+) reductase (FNR) family of electron transferases. This protein functions in the synthesis of methionine by regenerating methionine synthase to a functional state. Because methionine synthesis requires methyl-group transfer by a folate donor, activity of the encoded enzyme is important for folate metabolism and cellular methylation.
description.ru: Редуктаза метионинсинтазы участвует в поддержании её активности.

description.en: This gene encodes an enzyme that functions to both activate and deactivate arylamine and hydrazine drugs and carcinogens. A second polymorphic arylamine N-acetyltransferase gene (NAT1), is located near this gene (NAT2).
description.ru: N-ацетилтрансфераза участвует в ацетилировании различных соединений.

description.en: This gene, isolated using the differential display method to detect tissue-specific genes, is specifically expressed in kidney and liver. The encoded protein shows amino acid sequence similarity to N-acetyltransferases. A similar protein in Xenopus affects cell adhesion and gastrulation movements, and may be localized in the secretory pathway.
description.ru: N-ацетилтрансфераза связана с ацетилированием цистеиновых конъюгатов.

description.en: This gene encodes a subunit of the transcription factor complex nuclear factor-kappa-B (NFkB). The NFkB complex is expressed in numerous cell types and functions as a central activator of genes involved in inflammation and immune function. The protein encoded by this gene can function as both a transcriptional activator or repressor depending on its dimerization partner.
description.ru: Компонент транскрипционного комплекса NF-kappaB участвует в регуляции иммунных сигналов.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the caspase recruitment domain-containing NLR family. Family members play essential roles in innate immune response to a wide range of pathogenic organisms, tissue damage and other cellular stresses.
description.ru: Белок врождённого иммунитета участвует в образовании инфламмасомы.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the CATERPILLER family of cytoplasmic proteins. The encoded protein, which contains an N-terminal pyrin domain, a NACHT domain, a NACHT-associated domain, and a C-terminus leucine-rich repeat region, functions as an attenuating factor of inflammation by suppressing inflammatory responses in activated monocytes.
description.ru: Белок семейства NLR участвует в регуляции врождённого иммунитета.

description.en: This gene encodes a pyrin-like protein containing a pyrin domain, a nucleotide-binding site (NBS) domain, and a leucine-rich repeat (LRR) motif. This protein interacts with the apoptosis-associated speck-like protein PYCARD/ASC, which contains a caspase recruitment domain, and is a member of the NLRP3 inflammasome complex. This complex functions as an upstream activator of NF-kappaB signaling, and it plays a role in the regulation of inflammation, the immune response, and apoptosis.
description.ru: Компонент инфламмасомы участвует в активации воспалительного ответа.

description.en: This gene is a member of the Nod1/Apaf-1 family and encodes a protein with two caspase recruitment (CARD) domains and six leucine-rich repeats (LRRs). The protein is primarily expressed in the peripheral blood leukocytes. It plays a role in the immune response to intracellular bacterial lipopolysaccharides (LPS) by recognizing the muramyl dipeptide (MDP) derived from them and activating the NFKB protein.
description.ru: Внутриклеточный рецептор распознаёт бактериальные компоненты и участвует во врождённом иммунитете.

description.en: Nitric oxide is a reactive free radical which acts as a biologic mediator in several processes, including neurotransmission and antimicrobial and antitumoral activities. Nitric oxide is synthesized from L-arginine by nitric oxide synthases.
description.ru: Эндотелиальная NO-синтаза образует оксид азота.

description.en: This gene encodes glucocorticoid receptor, which can function both as a transcription factor that binds to glucocorticoid response elements in the promoters of glucocorticoid responsive genes to activate their transcription, and as a regulator of other transcription factors. This receptor is typically found in the cytoplasm, but upon ligand binding, is transported into the nucleus. It is involved in inflammatory responses, cellular proliferation, and differentiation in target tissues.
description.ru: Глюкокортикоидный рецептор участвует в регуляции транскрипции в ответ на глюкокортикоиды.

description.en: This gene encodes an enzyme that belongs to the Nudix hydrolase superfamily. Members of this superfamily catalyze the hydrolysis of nucleoside diphosphates, including substrates like 8-oxo-dGTP, which are a result of oxidative damage, and can induce base mispairing during DNA replication, causing transversions. The encoded enzyme is a negative regulator of thiopurine activation and toxicity.
description.ru: Фермент гидролизует нуклеозидные трифосфаты и ограничивает включение некоторых модифицированных нуклеотидов.

description.en: This gene encodes the coiled-coil containing protein optineurin. Optineurin may play a role in normal-tension glaucoma and adult-onset primary open angle glaucoma. Optineurin interacts with adenovirus E3-14.7K protein and may utilize tumor necrosis factor-alpha or Fas-ligand pathways to mediate apoptosis, inflammation or vasoconstriction.
description.ru: Оптинейрин участвует во внутриклеточном транспорте и клеточных сигнальных процессах.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to the G-protein coupled receptor family and acts as a receptor for oxytocin. Its activity is mediated by G proteins which activate a phosphatidylinositol-calcium second messenger system. The oxytocin-oxytocin receptor system plays an important role in the uterus during parturition.
description.ru: Окситоциновый рецептор передаёт сигнал через G-белки.

description.en: This gene is a member of a gene family which encodes enzymes responsible for the conversion of arginine residues to citrulline residues. This gene may play a role in granulocyte and macrophage development leading to inflammation and immune response.
description.ru: Пептидиларгинин-деиминаза катализирует цитруллинирование белков.

description.en: Predicted to enable signaling receptor activity. Predicted to be located in plasma membrane.
description.ru: Белок семейства рецепторов адипонектина/прогестина; часть функциональных характеристик остаётся предположительной.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the subtilisin-like proprotein convertase family, which includes proteases that process protein and peptide precursors trafficking through regulated or constitutive branches of the secretory pathway. The encoded protein undergoes an autocatalytic processing event with its prosegment in the ER and is constitutively secreted as an inactive protease into the extracellular matrix and trans-Golgi network. It is expressed in liver, intestine and kidney tissues and escorts specific receptors for lysosomal degradation.
description.ru: Белок участвует в регуляции количества рецепторов ЛПНП.

description.en: Phosphatidylcholine (PC) is the most abundant mammalian phospholipid. This gene encodes an enzyme which converts phosphatidylethanolamine to phosphatidylcholine by sequential methylation in the liver. Another distinct synthetic pathway in nucleated cells converts intracellular choline to phosphatidylcholine by a three-step process.
description.ru: Фосфатидилэтаноламин-N-метилтрансфераза участвует в синтезе фосфатидилхолина.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the steroid receptor superfamily. Two of the isoforms (A and B) are identical except for an additional 165 amino acids found in the N-terminus of isoform B and mediate their own response genes and physiologic effects with little overlap.
description.ru: Прогестероновый рецептор регулирует транскрипцию в ответ на прогестерон.

description.en: Phosphoinositide 3-kinases (PI3Ks) phosphorylate inositol lipids and are involved in the immune response. The protein encoded by this gene is a class I PI3K found primarily in leukocytes. Like other class I PI3Ks (p110-alpha p110-beta, and p110-gamma), the encoded protein binds p85 adapter proteins and GTP-bound RAS.
description.ru: Каталитическая субъединица PI3K участвует в фосфоинозитидной сигнализации, в том числе в иммунных клетках.

description.en: Phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase phosphorylates the inositol ring of phosphatidylinositol at the 3-prime position. The enzyme comprises a 110 kD catalytic subunit and a regulatory subunit of either 85, 55, or 50 kD. This gene encodes the 85 kD regulatory subunit.
description.ru: Регуляторная субъединица PI3K участвует в фосфоинозитидной сигнализации.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a triacylglycerol lipase that mediates triacylglycerol hydrolysis in adipocytes. The encoded protein, which appears to be membrane bound, may be involved in the balance of energy usage/storage in adipocytes.
description.ru: Белок связан с обменом липидов; описана липазная активность.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR) subfamily of nuclear receptors. PPARs form heterodimers with retinoid X receptors (RXRs) and these heterodimers regulate transcription of various genes. Three subtypes of PPARs are known: PPAR-alpha, PPAR-delta, and PPAR-gamma.
description.ru: Ядерный рецептор участвует в регуляции транскрипции и липидного обмена.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the PPM family of Mn2+/Mg2+-dependent protein phosphatases. The encoded protein, essential for cell survival and development, is targeted to the mitochondria where it plays a key role in regulation of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore.
description.ru: Митохондриальная протеинфосфатаза участвует в регуляции белков.

description.en: The precise function of this gene is unknown; however, the encoded protein is a component of a multiprotein E3 ubiquitin ligase complex that mediates the targeting of substrate proteins for proteasomal degradation.
description.ru: E3-убиквитинлигаза паркин участвует в убиквитинировании белков и клеточном контроле качества.

description.en: This gene encodes a mitochondrial protein that catalyzes the first step in proline degradation.
description.ru: Митохондриальный фермент катализирует первый этап распада пролина.

description.en: This gene encodes a trypsinogen, which is a member of the trypsin family of serine proteases. This enzyme is secreted by the pancreas and cleaved to its active form in the small intestine. It is active on peptide linkages involving the carboxyl group of lysine or arginine.
description.ru: Кодирует трипсиноген — предшественник пищеварительной протеазы трипсина.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene belongs to a subfamily of the phosphotransferases. This encoded enzyme is responsible for the third and last step in L-serine formation. It catalyzes magnesium-dependent hydrolysis of L-phosphoserine and is also involved in an exchange reaction between L-serine and L-phosphoserine.
description.ru: Фосфосеринфосфатаза катализирует заключительный этап синтеза L-серина.

description.en: This gene encodes a cytoskeletal protein that is highly expressed in hemopoietic tissues. This protein functions via its interaction with several different proteins involved in cytoskeletal organization and inflammatory processes. It binds to the cytoplasmic tail of CD2, an effector of T cell activation and adhesion, downregulating CD2-triggered adhesion.
description.ru: Цитоскелетный белок взаимодействует с белками организации цитоскелета и клеточной сигнализации.

description.en: This gene encodes of member of the non-receptor class 4 subfamily of the protein-tyrosine phosphatase family. The encoded protein is a lymphoid-specific intracellular phosphatase that associates with the molecular adapter protein CBL and may be involved in regulating CBL function in the T-cell receptor signaling pathway.
description.ru: Внутриклеточная тирозинфосфатаза участвует в регуляции сигналов лимфоцитов.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is one of the essential components of the machinery involved in co-translational insertion of selenocysteine (Sec) into selenoproteins. Sec is encoded by the UGA codon, which normally signals translation termination. The recoding of UGA as Sec codon requires a Sec insertion sequence (SECIS) element; present in the 3' untranslated regions of eukaryotic selenoprotein mRNAs.
description.ru: Участвует во включении селеноцистеина в селенопротеины.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a serine protease inhibitor belonging to the serpin superfamily whose targets include elastase, plasmin, thrombin, trypsin, chymotrypsin, and plasminogen activator. This protein is produced in the liver, the bone marrow, by lymphocytic and monocytic cells in lymphoid tissue, and by the Paneth cells of the gut.
description.ru: Альфа-1-антитрипсин ингибирует сериновые протеазы.

description.en: This gene encodes a steroid binding protein that was first described as a plasma protein secreted by the liver but is now thought to participate in the regulation of steroid responses. The encoded protein transports androgens and estrogens in the blood, binding each steroid molecule as a dimer formed from identical or nearly identical monomers.
description.ru: Белок связывает половые стероиды и участвует в их переносе и доступности.

description.en: This gene encodes the cytosolic form of serine hydroxymethyltransferase, a pyridoxal phosphate-containing enzyme that catalyzes the reversible conversion of serine and tetrahydrofolate to glycine and 5,10-methylene tetrahydrofolate. This reaction provides one-carbon units for synthesis of methionine, thymidylate, and purines in the cytoplasm. A pseudogene of this gene is located on the short arm of chromosome 1.
description.ru: Серин-гидроксиметилтрансфераза участвует в обмене серина, глицина и одноуглеродных групп.

description.en: This gene encodes a sodium/bile acid cotransporter. This transporter is the primary mechanism for uptake of intestinal bile acids by apical cells in the distal ileum. Bile acids are the catabolic product of cholesterol metabolism, so this protein is also critical for cholesterol homeostasis.
description.ru: Натрий-зависимый транспортёр желчных кислот обеспечивает их захват в кишечнике.

description.en: Enables carnitine transmembrane transporter activity and creatine transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in carnitine transmembrane transport; creatine transmembrane transport; and urate metabolic process. Located in plasma membrane.
description.ru: Транспортёр связан с переносом карнитина и креатина.

description.en: Polyspecific organic cation transporters in the liver, kidney, intestine, and other organs are critical for elimination of many endogenous small organic cations as well as a wide array of drugs and environmental toxins. This gene is one of three similar cation transporter genes located in a cluster on chromosome 6. The encoded protein contains twelve putative transmembrane domains and is a plasma integral membrane protein.
description.ru: Транспортёр органических катионов участвует в захвате и выведении различных соединений.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the organic anion transporter (OAT) family, and it acts as a urate transporter to regulate urate levels in blood. This protein is an integral membrane protein primarily found in epithelial cells of the proximal tubule of the kidney.
description.ru: Транспортёр урата участвует в регуляции его переноса в почках.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the SLC2A facilitative glucose transporter family. Members of this family play a significant role in maintaining glucose homeostasis. The encoded protein may play a role in the development and survival of chondrocytes in cartilage matrices.
description.ru: Мембранный транспортёр семейства SLC2 участвует в переносе малых молекул, включая урат.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a zinc efflux transporter involved in the accumulation of zinc in intracellular vesicles. This gene is expressed at a high level only in the pancreas, particularly in islets of Langerhans. The encoded protein colocalizes with insulin in the secretory pathway granules of the insulin-secreting INS-1 cells.
description.ru: Цинковый транспортёр участвует в накоплении цинка во внутриклеточных везикулах.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the sodium:neurotransmitter symporter family. This member is a multi-pass membrane protein, which is responsible for reuptake of norepinephrine into presynaptic nerve terminals and is a regulator of norepinephrine homeostasis.
description.ru: Транспортёр обеспечивает обратный захват норадреналина.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a cationic amino acid transporter and a member of the APC (amino acid-polyamine-organocation) family of transporters. The encoded membrane protein is responsible for the cellular uptake of arginine, lysine and ornithine.
description.ru: Мембранный транспортёр участвует в переносе катионных аминокислот.

description.en: This gene encodes a liver-specific member of the organic anion transporter family. The encoded protein is a transmembrane receptor that mediates the sodium-independent uptake of numerous endogenous compounds including bilirubin, 17-beta-glucuronosyl estradiol and leukotriene C4. This protein is also involved in the removal of drug compounds such as statins, bromosulfophthalein and rifampin from the blood into the hepatocytes.
description.ru: Печёночный транспортёр органических анионов участвует в захвате эндогенных соединений и лекарств.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a trypsin inhibitor, which is secreted from pancreatic acinar cells into pancreatic juice. It is thought to function in the prevention of trypsin-catalyzed premature activation of zymogens within the pancreas and the pancreatic duct.
description.ru: Ингибитор трипсина участвует в защите поджелудочной железы от преждевременной протеолитической активности.

description.en: Steroid 5-alpha-reductase (EC 1.3.99.5) catalyzes the conversion of testosterone into the more potent androgen, dihydrotestosterone (DHT). Also see SRD5A2 (MIM 607306).[supplied by OMIM, Mar 2008]
description.ru: Стероид-5-альфа-редуктаза превращает тестостерон в дигидротестостерон.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the STAT protein family. In response to cytokines and growth factors, STAT family members are phosphorylated by the receptor associated kinases, and then form homo- or heterodimers that translocate to the cell nucleus where they act as transcription activators. The protein encoded by this gene can be activated by various ligands including interferon-alpha, interferon-gamma, EGF, PDGF and IL6.
description.ru: Транскрипционный фактор передаёт сигналы цитокинов и факторов роста.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the STAT protein family. In response to cytokines and growth factors, STAT family members are phosphorylated by the receptor associated kinases, and then form homo- or heterodimers that translocate to the cell nucleus where they act as transcription activators. This protein is activated through phosphorylation in response to various cytokines and growth factors including IFNs, EGF, IL5, IL6, HGF, LIF and BMP2.
description.ru: Транскрипционный фактор передаёт сигналы цитокинов и факторов роста.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the STAT family of transcription factors. In response to cytokines and growth factors, STAT family members are phosphorylated by the receptor associated kinases, and then form homo- or heterodimers that translocate to the cell nucleus where they act as transcription activators. This protein is essential for mediating responses to IL12 in lymphocytes, and regulating the differentiation of T helper cells.
description.ru: Транскрипционный фактор передаёт сигналы цитокинов.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the sulfotransferase family. Sulfotransferases aid in the metabolism of drugs and endogenous compounds by converting these substances into more hydrophilic water-soluble sulfate conjugates that can be easily excreted.
description.ru: Сульфотрансфераза участвует в конъюгации стероидов и других соединений с сульфатом.

description.en: This gene encodes a high mobility group (HMG) box-containing transcription factor that plays a key role in the Wnt signaling pathway. The protein has been implicated in blood glucose homeostasis.
description.ru: Транскрипционный фактор участвует в Wnt-сигнализации.

description.en: Thyroglobulin (Tg) is a glycoprotein homodimer produced predominantly by the thryroid gland. It acts as a substrate for the synthesis of thyroxine and triiodothyronine as well as the storage of the inactive forms of thyroid hormone and iodine. Thyroglobulin is secreted from the endoplasmic reticulum to its site of iodination, and subsequent thyroxine biosynthesis, in the follicular lumen.
description.ru: Тиреоглобулин служит субстратом для синтеза тиреоидных гормонов.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is involved in the conversion of tyrosine to dopamine. It is the rate-limiting enzyme in the synthesis of catecholamines, hence plays a key role in the physiology of adrenergic neurons.
description.ru: Тирозингидроксилаза участвует в синтезе катехоламинов.

description.en: This gene is the target of 2p21 choromosomal aberrations in benign thyroid adenomas. The encoded protein is likely involved in the death receptor pathway and apoptosis.
description.ru: Справочник описывает ассоциации гена, но не устанавливает точный биохимический механизм его продукта.

description.en: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in regulation of lipid metabolic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane and endoplasmic reticulum-Golgi intermediate compartment membrane.
description.ru: Белок связан с регуляцией липидного обмена и мембранами эндоплазматического ретикулума.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a type II transmembrane serine proteinase that is found attached to the cell surface. The encoded protein may be involved in matrix remodeling processes in the liver.
description.ru: Мембранная сериновая протеаза; изменения функции связаны с регуляцией обмена железа.

description.en: This gene encodes a multifunctional proinflammatory cytokine that belongs to the tumor necrosis factor (TNF) superfamily. This cytokine is mainly secreted by macrophages. It can bind to, and thus functions through its receptors TNFRSF1A/TNFR1 and TNFRSF1B/TNFBR.
description.ru: Провоспалительный цитокин участвует в иммунной сигнализации.

description.en: This gene was identified as a gene whose expression is rapidly induced by the tumor necrosis factor (TNF). The protein encoded by this gene is a zinc finger protein and ubiqitin-editing enzyme, and has been shown to inhibit NF-kappa B activation as well as TNF-mediated apoptosis. The encoded protein, which has both ubiquitin ligase and deubiquitinase activities, is involved in the cytokine-mediated immune and inflammatory responses.
description.ru: Белок A20 участвует в регуляции убиквитинирования и воспалительных сигналов.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a member of the TNF-receptor superfamily. This protein is an osteoblast-secreted decoy receptor that functions as a negative regulator of bone resorption. This protein specifically binds to its ligand, osteoprotegerin ligand, both of which are key extracellular regulators of osteoclast development.
description.ru: Остеопротегерин — секретируемый рецептор-ловушка, участвующий в регуляции резорбции кости.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the TNF receptor superfamily of proteins. The encoded receptor is found in membrane-bound and soluble forms that interact with membrane-bound and soluble forms, respectively, of its ligand, tumor necrosis factor alpha. Binding of membrane-bound tumor necrosis factor alpha to the membrane-bound receptor induces receptor trimerization and activation, which plays a role in cell survival, apoptosis, and inflammation.
description.ru: Рецептор TNF участвует в передаче его сигнала.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a nuclear import receptor for serine/arginine-rich (SR) proteins such as the splicing factors SFRS1 and SFRS2. The encoded protein has also been shown to be involved in HIV-1 infection, apparently through interaction with the HIV-1 capsid protein.
description.ru: Транспортин-3 участвует в ядерном импорте белков, богатых серином и аргинином.

description.en: This gene encodes the enzyme that metabolizes thiopurine drugs via S-adenosyl-L-methionine as the S-methyl donor and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine as a byproduct. Thiopurine drugs such as 6-mercaptopurine are used as chemotherapeutic agents. Related pseudogenes have been identified on chromosomes 3, 18 and X.
description.ru: Тиопурин-S-метилтрансфераза участвует в метаболизме тиопуриновых соединений.

description.en: This gene encodes a membrane-bound glycoprotein. The encoded protein acts as an enzyme and plays a central role in thyroid gland function. The protein functions in the iodination of tyrosine residues in thyroglobulin and phenoxy-ester formation between pairs of iodinated tyrosines to generate the thyroid hormones, thyroxine and triiodothyronine.
description.ru: Тиреопероксидаза участвует в йодировании субстратов и синтезе тиреоидных гормонов.

description.en: This gene encodes a protein involved in regulating responses to cytokines by members of the Rel/NF-kappaB transcription factor family. These factors play a central role in innate immunity in response to pathogens, inflammatory signals and stress. This gene product interacts with TRAF proteins (tumor necrosis factor receptor-associated factors) and either I-kappaB kinase or MAP kinase to activate either NF-kappaB or Jun kinase.
description.ru: Адаптерный белок участвует в регуляции цитокиновых сигналов через NF-kappaB.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is a membrane protein and a major controller of thyroid cell metabolism. The encoded protein is a receptor for thyrothropin and thyrostimulin, and its activity is mediated by adenylate cyclase. Defects in this gene are a cause of several types of hyperthyroidism.
description.ru: Рецептор тиреотропного гормона участвует в регуляции функции клеток щитовидной железы.

description.en: This gene encodes a UDP-glucuronosyltransferase, an enzyme of the glucuronidation pathway that transforms small lipophilic molecules, such as steroids, bilirubin, hormones, and drugs, into water-soluble, excretable metabolites. This gene is part of a complex locus that encodes several UDP-glucuronosyltransferases. The locus includes thirteen unique alternate first exons followed by four common exons.
description.ru: Глюкуронозилтрансфераза участвует в конъюгации билирубина и других малых молекул.

description.en: The protein encoded by this gene is the most abundant protein in mammalian urine under physiological conditions. Its excretion in urine follows proteolytic cleavage of the ectodomain of its glycosyl phosphatidylinosital-anchored counterpart that is situated on the luminal cell surface of the loop of Henle. This protein may act as a constitutive inhibitor of calcium crystallization in renal fluids.
description.ru: Уромодулин — белок, секретируемый в мочу клетками почек.

description.en: This gene encodes vitamin D3 receptor, which is a member of the nuclear hormone receptor superfamily of ligand-inducible transcription factors. This receptor also functions as a receptor for the secondary bile acid, lithocholic acid. A recent study provided evidence for translational readthrough in this gene, and expression of an additional C-terminally extended isoform via the use of an alternative in-frame translation termination codon.
description.ru: Рецептор витамина D регулирует транскрипцию в ответ на его активный метаболит.

description.en: This gene encodes the catalytic subunit of the vitamin K epoxide reductase complex, which is responsible for the reduction of inactive vitamin K 2,3-epoxide to active vitamin K in the endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Vitamin K is a required co-factor for carboxylation of glutamic acid residues by vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylase in blood-clotting enzymes. Pseudogenes of this gene are located on chromosomes 1 and X.
description.ru: Витамин-K-эпоксидредуктаза участвует в восстановлении витамина K.

description.en: This gene encodes a member of the WD repeat protein family. WD repeats are minimally conserved regions of approximately 40 amino acids typically bracketed by gly-his and trp-asp (GH-WD), which may facilitate formation of heterotrimeric or multiprotein complexes. Members of this family are involved in a variety of cellular processes, including cell cycle progression, signal transduction, apoptosis, and gene regulation.
description.ru: Белок с WD-повторами связан с белковыми взаимодействиями и клеточными процессами.

description.en: The WNT gene family consists of structurally related genes which encode secreted signaling proteins. These proteins have been implicated in oncogenesis and in several developmental processes, including regulation of cell fate and patterning during embryogenesis. This gene is a member of the WNT gene family, and is the first signaling molecule shown to influence the sex-determination cascade.
description.ru: Секретируемый сигнальный белок участвует в развитии тканей через Wnt-сигнализацию.

description.en: This gene encodes a zinc finger protein of the Kruppel family. The protein contains a SCAN box and a KRAB A domain and may be involved in transcriptional regulation. A similar protein in mouse is differentially expressed in spermatogenesis.
description.ru: Белок с цинковыми пальцами; участие в регуляции транскрипции описано предположительно.

description.en: Factor V Leiden changes an activated protein C cleavage site: factor Va is inactivated less efficiently, favouring coagulation. The association concerns venous thrombosis; a molecular mechanism is not an individual risk estimate.
description.ru: Factor V Leiden меняет участок расщепления активированным протеином C: фактор Va инактивируется менее эффективно, что способствует свёртыванию. Ассоциация относится к венозному тромбозу; молекулярный механизм не определяет индивидуальный риск.

description.en: G20210A is in the prothrombin gene's 3′ untranslated region. The A allele was associated with higher plasma prothrombin and venous thrombosis in the cited study; this does not predict a person's prothrombin concentration or outcome.
description.ru: G20210A находится в 3′-нетранслируемой области гена протромбина. В указанном исследовании аллель A был связан с более высоким протромбином плазмы и венозным тромбозом; это не предсказывает концентрацию протромбина или исход у человека.

description.en: APOB R3527Q affects the LDL-receptor binding region of apolipoprotein B; impaired LDL clearance is the relevant pathway. A variant description does not establish a diagnosis.
description.ru: APOB R3527Q затрагивает область связывания аполипопротеина B с рецептором ЛПНП; значимый путь — нарушение удаления ЛПНП. Описание варианта не устанавливает диагноз.

rs5742904.source: GenCC Definitive (APOB — familial hypercholesterolaemia); ClinVar pathogenic

description.en: Together with rs7412 this position distinguishes APOE isoforms involved in lipoprotein transport. A single SNP does not determine the complete ε genotype or an individual lipid profile.
description.ru: Вместе с rs7412 эта позиция различает изоформы APOE, участвующие в транспорте липопротеинов. Один SNP не определяет полный ε-генотип или индивидуальный липидный профиль.

description.en: Together with rs429358 this position distinguishes APOE isoforms. ε2-related lipid associations depend on the complete genotype and other factors; this row alone cannot establish them for a person.
description.ru: Вместе с rs429358 эта позиция различает изоформы APOE. Связанные с ε2 липидные ассоциации зависят от полного генотипа и других факторов; одна строка их у человека не устанавливает.

rs7412.source: Bennet 2007 JAMA; Mahley 2009 (type III hyperlipoproteinaemia in ε2/ε2)

description.en: The curated literature links the G allele to higher lipoprotein(a). The association does not measure Lp(a), identify all causal variation or determine an individual's cardiovascular risk.
description.ru: Курируемая литература связывает аллель G с более высоким липопротеином(а). Ассоциация не измеряет Лп(а), не определяет все причинные варианты или индивидуальный сердечно-сосудистый риск.

description.en: LPA I4399M (C) is linked to higher lipoprotein(a) in the curated literature; a measured Lp(a) concentration cannot be inferred from this position.
description.ru: LPA I4399M (C) связан с более высоким липопротеином(а) в курируемой литературе; измеренную концентрацию Лп(а) по этой позиции получить нельзя.

description.en: ADRB1 Arg389/Gly389 concerns beta-1 adrenergic receptor signalling. Functional and beta-blocker response studies do not establish a genotype-based treatment rule.
description.ru: ADRB1 Arg389/Gly389 относится к передаче сигнала бета-1-адренорецептором. Функциональные исследования и исследования ответа на бета-блокаторы не устанавливают правило лечения по генотипу.

rs1801253.source: the locus catalogue; no CPIC/DPWG guideline for beta-blockers

description.en: F13A1 Val34Leu is linked to faster factor XIII activation and altered clot structure. The curated literature reports a venous thrombosis association; it is not a personal protective guarantee.
description.ru: F13A1 Val34Leu связан с более быстрой активацией фактора XIII и изменением структуры сгустка. Курируемая литература описывает ассоциацию с венозным тромбозом; это не гарантия защиты человека.

rs5985.source: PMID 16740590 (Wells 2006: factor XIII Val34Leu is protective against VTE, HuGE review and meta-analysis); PMID 12358922 (Van Hylckama Vlieg 2002)

description.en: ITGA2 C807T is linked to platelet collagen-receptor expression and an ischaemic stroke association in the curated literature. Receptor biology is not an individual event prediction.
description.ru: ITGA2 C807T связан с экспрессией рецептора коллагена на тромбоцитах и ассоциацией с ишемическим инсультом в курируемой литературе. Биология рецептора не предсказывает событие у человека.

rs1126643.source: PMID 16820192 (Nikolopoulos 2007: ITGA2 C807T and ischemic stroke, meta-analysis); PMID 26556301 (Nissinen 2016: platelet response and α2β1 integrin)

description.en: ITGB3 PlA1/PlA2 concerns platelet integrin GPIIIa; the curated literature reports associations with arterial events. A consistent personal effect or treatment rule is not established by this row.
description.ru: ITGB3 PlA1/PlA2 относится к тромбоцитарному интегрину GPIIIa; курируемая литература описывает ассоциации с артериальными событиями. Эта строка не устанавливает устойчивый индивидуальный эффект или правило лечения.

rs5918.source: PMID 11341496 (Di Castelnuovo 2001: PlA1/PlA2 and coronary risk, meta-analysis); PMID 38920993 (Coadă 2024: PlA1/A2 and stroke, updated meta-analysis); PMID 23834376

description.en: FGB −455G/A is a promoter variant linked to fibrinogen beta-chain synthesis and circulating fibrinogen. The association is not a measurement of this person's fibrinogen.
description.ru: FGB −455G/A — промоторный вариант, связанный с синтезом бета-цепи фибриногена и циркулирующим фибриногеном. Ассоциация не измеряет фибриноген этого человека.

rs1800790.source: PMID 22388766 (Ken-Dror 2012: a genetic instrument for Mendelian randomization of fibrinogen); PMID 39674435 (Ken-Dror 2025)

description.en: G6PD V68M is part of the A− allele context. Reduced red-cell G6PD activity can affect oxidative stress tolerance and red-cell survival; a single position does not establish enzyme activity or a complete haplotype.
description.ru: G6PD V68M входит в контекст аллеля A−. Снижение активности G6PD эритроцитов может менять устойчивость к окислительному стрессу и срок жизни клеток; одна позиция не определяет активность фермента или полный гаплотип.

rs1050828.source: CPIC G6PD (Gammal 2023); Wheeler 2017 PLoS Med (HbA1c underestimates glycaemia in G6PD deficiency)

description.en: G6PD S188F is the Mediterranean variant associated with reduced enzyme function. Red-cell survival and oxidative stress are the relevant pathways; sex and the actual enzyme phenotype matter.
description.ru: G6PD S188F — средиземноморский вариант, связанный со сниженной функцией фермента. Значимые пути — срок жизни эритроцитов и окислительный стресс; важны пол и фактический ферментный фенотип.

description.en: The T allele is associated with type 2 diabetes in the curated literature. TCF7L2 regulates transcription in glucose and incretin-related pathways; the association does not establish an individual's insulin secretion.
description.ru: Аллель T связан с диабетом 2 типа в курируемой литературе. TCF7L2 регулирует транскрипцию в путях глюкозы и инкретинов; ассоциация не устанавливает секрецию инсулина у человека.

description.en: GCKR P446L concerns hepatic glucokinase regulation. The curated literature links L446 to lower fasting glucose and higher triglycerides; these are population associations, not predicted laboratory values.
description.ru: GCKR P446L относится к регуляции глюкокиназы печени. Курируемая литература связывает L446 с более низкой глюкозой натощак и более высокими триглицеридами; это популяционные ассоциации, а не предсказанные результаты анализов.

description.en: PPARG Pro12Ala concerns a regulator of adipocyte differentiation and metabolism; Ala12 is linked to a modestly lower type 2 diabetes association in the curated literature.
description.ru: PPARG Pro12Ala относится к регулятору дифференцировки адипоцитов и обмена; Ala12 связан с умеренно более низкой ассоциацией с диабетом 2 типа в курируемой литературе.

description.en: SLC22A1 R61C is described as a reduced-function OCT1 allele. Studies disagree on the clinical metformin response; transporter function alone does not select a medicine or dose.
